MESSAGE FROM DANA:
I'm thinking of adopting a cat. Help me get ready.

response.text: That's wonderful, Dana! To get ready, start by cat-proofing your home—secure loose cords, remove toxic plants, and set up a cozy corner with a bed, litter box, and scratching post. I'd also recommend scheduling a vet visit soon after adoption and stocking up on food, bowls, and toys. Let me know if you want a detailed checklist!
